sources.title: Конструктивные и эксплуатационные параметры двигателя 4АН315S12У3 — анализ обмотки статора
А. Э. Кравчик и др. Асинхронные двигатели серии 4А — 4АН315S12У3

notes: The model-specific prose identifies a rigid two-layer concentric stator winding with 90 stator slots and rectangular copper conductor 1.6×3.55 mm.
Average turn length 1450 mm and stator slot height 42.5 mm are preserved as source-native geometry/reference values.

The HTML rendering of table 3 exposes the raw sequence '1-8 / 10+10 / 4/2 / 1.50/1.58', but column alignment conflicts with the clearer prose conductor statement; these values are preserved only in source_raw_table_notation and are not normalized into pitch/turn/branch fields.
The study also calculates a theoretical pitch near 6.4 slots; that calculated result is not promoted to winding_pitch_source.
